Commentary.Commentary: Australia's death bowling wasn't accurate and they ended up conceding in excess of 50 runs in the last five overs. Imad Wasim, in particular, provided the much-needed impetus with his late cameo and has handed his team some extra runs to play with. We have already talked a lot about the pitch. It will assist the slow bowlers and the Kangaroos will have to plan their chase well. The start against the two new balls will be very crucial. Do join us in a short while for Australia's reply.

Coming back to the summary of this innings, it was a crucial toss to win for Pakistan. Batting first in this part of the world was a no brainer and the hosts did get a good start as well. They were a bit slow in their approach but maybe the plan was to go big at the death. The Aussie spinners performed decently but given the nature of this surface, Aaron Finch would have wished for more wickets from them. The partnership between Umar Akmal and Haris Sohail put some urgency in their scoring but post the second Drinks break, a couple of quick wickets fell and that hurt Pakistan's proceedings a bit.

Umar Akmal is giving a quick interview. He is pleased with his comeback but is not satisfied with his batting entirely. Mentions that his role was to bat till the end but he failed to do so. Adds that he just batted his natural way and that was the advice from the head coach. Further says that he has worked on his game in the last few years by playing plenty of domestic cricket and hopes to keep performing for Pakistan.

Some good hitting towards the end has powered Pakistan to a very challenging total on this slowish pitch. Although Haris Sohail will be criticized by a few for batting slowly, his knock in a way made sure that runs keep coming from one end. The pitch is quite demanding and it wasn't aiding stroke play. Keeping all those factors in mind, his innings very well might prove to be a match-winning one.

FOUR! Yes, he can. Very full delivery on middle and leg, it is in Wasim's slot. He lofts it over mid-wicket. Maxwell runs in from deep square leg and puts in a dive in an attempt to stop it from going to the fence. He gets to the ball but his leg touched the ropes. He signals it as boundary straight away but the umpire goes upstairs and replays confirm it. Pakistan end on 280/5.
Slower bouncer from Coulter-Nile. Haris pulls it away for a single. 11 runs off the over so far. Can Wasim get a boundary off the last ball?
Finally NCN attempts a yorker. He misses it as Imad comes down the track. He hits it wide of mid off where Lyon dives to his left and stops it. He cannot stop the single though.

FOUR! Two in two for Wasim. This is poor delivery from Coulter-Nile. Rather than going for a yorker he serves this on a length outside off, Wasim frees his arm and slaps it  over cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery around off, Wasim gets his front foot out of the line and whips it through covers for a boundary.

Maiden ODI century for Haris Sohail. What a knock this has been from the southpaw. Not an easy pitch to play your shots but he took his time and has looked very good. He gets there by flicking the length ball on the pads towards square leg for a single.
Another full ball, Sohail drives it to the extra cover fielder and keeps strike for the final over.
Full ball outside off, Imad flicks it to the on side and takes a quick single.
A full toss outside off, Wasim shuffles across and drags it through square leg for a brace.
SIX! Effortless! Too full in length around middle and off, Imad sits down on one knee and slog sweeps it over square leg for a maximum.
Gets across the stumps and hits it down to long on for a run.

Slower ball on off, Sohail goes on the front foot and goes for the sweep on this one but gets it off the toe of the bat. The ball lobs up in the air but goes on the bounce to the fielder at long on. One run taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Wasim looks to whack this through covers but gets a thick outside edge. The ball runs down to third man and a single is taken.
This time finds the fielder. Length delivery on leg, Wasim looks to hit it wide of the mid on fielder but hits it straight to him.
FOUR! Finally Wasim gets bat on ball and gets the desired result. Seam-up delivery which is bowled on a length. Wasim takes his front foot out of the line and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
This time Wasim stays in his crease and looks to hit this length ball on the off side. He gets beaten by the pace and misses it.
Wasim is not gonna hang around. First ball he is facing and he comes down the track. NCN sees it and bowls it short. Imad misses his shot.
Slower delivery outside off, Sohail tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Imad Wasim is the new man in.

OUT! Well caught, Stoinis! A length ball around off, angling away, Ashraf tries driving from the crease but ends up slicing it off the outer edge towards backward point. Stoinis stretches to his right and takes a fine catch with a tumble. There was Zampa also present and luckily he didn't intervene.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Ashraf was trying to drive this one on the up, the ball again takes the edge of the bat. With the pace of Jhye, the ball raced past the keeper who tried a diving effort but was nowhere close. The ball crosses the third man fence.
Tad fuller this one, punched off the back foot to the cover for a single.
FOUR! Goes shorter this time, the ball takes the outer edge of the bat and races to the third man fence. Boundary signaled.
Full on off, driven to the covers.
Starts with a full ball outside off, Faheem goes to drive it to the off side, but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fielder.
Bowling change. Jhye Richardson is back to bowl at the death.
Back of a length delivery, Ashraf pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple. 13 runs off this one.

FOUR! How unlucky is Nathan Coulter-Nile? Full outside off, Ashraf looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. And just like the previous boundary of the over this one also goes to the third man fence.
Follows it up with a single to long on.

FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler. Full length delivery on off, Sohail looks to drive it on the up but gets a thick outside edge. There is no slip in place and the ball races away to the third man fence. Not the most convincing way to get to your highest ODI score but he will take it.
On the pads, Faheem tries to flick it but it goes towards fine leg of his pad for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Sohail hits it wide of the fielder at mid on for a single.
Nathan Couler-Nile back into the attack.

FOUR! CRACKED! Ashraf reads the length of this ball early and goes on the back foot to cut it. He gets perfect timing on that one and the ball goes through point for a boundary. The deep point fielder was nowhere near this one.
Ashraf defends this one by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Flighted outside off, Ashraf guides it straight to the fielder at third man.
Tossed up on middle, Sohail drives it to the right of long on. The fielder covers it quickly and a single taken.
Tossed up on off, Haris goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Bowls a slider this time, Sohail goes on the back foot and cuts it hard through point. A brace taken.
On the pads, Haris flicks it to fine leg and keeps the strike. Zampa finishes off with the figures of 10-0-44-0.
Short and wide outside off, Sohail cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at point.
Shorter outside off, Ashraf punches it to deep cover for a single.
Flighted on middle and leg, Sohail lofts it towards long on. It goes to the fielder on a bounce for a single.
Premeditated sweep from Faheem. This is bowled slow and full on off, Faheem sweeps it to backward square leg for a single.
Flighted around off, Faheem tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Goes on the back foot to this length ball and punches it to the off side. One run taken.
Floated delivery outside off, Sohail finds the gap at covers and goes for the single. The deep cover fielder throws it quickly back to the keeper.
Tossed up on off, flicked towards mid on for a single.
Ashraf goes for the reverse sweep but it's hit straight to the fielder at gully.
Floated on off, pushed through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Short and on off, Sohail backs off and cuts it hard through backward point for a boundary. The fielder tries a diving save but fails to get the hand on ball.
Single to end the over. Short again from Zampa. Sohail slaps it to sweeper cover to keep the strike. 7 off this over.
Shorter outside off, Faheem punches it to deep cover for a single.
Follows the edgy boundary with a solid front foot defense to this loopy delivery.

FOUR! Edge but Ashraf will take it. Wrong 'un on off, Ashraf looks to defend it but gets a thick outside edge which goes past Usman Khawaja at first slip and runs towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Lovely flight from Zampa. Bowls it really slow. Faheem looks to sweep it but gets it off the bottom edge of the bat towards the bowler.
Shorter delivery outside off. The ball stays low but Sohail manages to flat bat it to long on for a single. 200 up for Pakistan.
Adam Zampa back into the attack.

Edgy! This one straightens from a full length around middle, Ashraf closes the face of the bat early as he attempts to flick. It takes the leading edge and runs down to third man for a couple of runs.
Lands it full and outside off, Sohail strokes it through covers for a run.
Goes on the back foot and punches it past the diving bowler for a run at long off.
Gets behind the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wide! Slips one down the leg side, Sohail tries flicking but misses.
Ashraf has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Powerplay 3 signalled by the umpire. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On a length outside off, Sohail steers it through point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for one.
Straighter in line, Faheem turns it off his pads but finds mid-wicket.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Faheem Ashraf is the new batsman.

OUT! Maxwell has the last laugh! He slips in a slider around middle and leg, Malik once again tries to play with the spin which is non-existent there. It skids past the outside edge and breaks the stumps behind. A big breakthrough for the Aussies.
SIX! Malik has decided to target Maxwell here. This one is a better executed shot from the Pakistan skipper. He shimmies down the track and dismisses it with the turn over wide long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Not timed well though. Loopy and full, Malik advances down the track and mistimes his lofted shot towards wide long off for a boundary.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot.
Beaten! Skidding away from the batsman, Malik tries to cut but misses.
Walks forward and knocks it down through mid on for a run.
On a length again, around off, Malik pushes inside the line and gets a soft outside edge behind. Doesn't carry to Carey. End of a successful over for the Aussies.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Malik plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for one.
Shoaib Malik is in next.

OUT! A wicket immediately after the break, we have seen that happening multiple times in cricket. Yet another length ball is served by Coulter-Nile. Umar Akmal is too early into his shot as he tries to hit it over the bowler's head. Ends up miscuing it towards mid off where Finch moves back a bit to claim the catch. The 98-run partnership comes to an end. A vital phase is beginning in this match...
On a good length outside off, Akmal mistimes his cut towards backward point.

Drinks break. Steady going from Pakistan and this partnership is scoring at a good rate too. Australia have bowled well but would like to pick a few wickets to keep things under check. Nathan Coulter-Nile is brought back into the attack.
On the pads, Akmal flicks it away for a single. 5 singles off the over.
Shorter on middle and leg, Akmal hits it straight to mid-wicket.
Fourth single of the over. This one is pushed wide of cover.
Loopy delivery on off, Akmal runs it down to long off for a run.
Tossed up on off, Sohail plays it to long off and rotates the strike.
Flighted on off and middle, Umar guides it to long on for a run.
Length ball on middle, Akmal milks it to long on for a run. 8 runs off the over despite one going for a maximum.
Length ball outside off, Sohail runs it down to point for a single.
Bouncer. It is around off, Sohail looks to pull it but misses.
Follows the biggie with a dot ball. Length ball on the pads, Haris flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
SIX!  Straight behind the bowler's head. Back of a length off cutter from Stoinis. Sohail hits it over the bowler's head with a cross bat for a maximum.
Length ball outside off, it comes in with the angle. Sohail pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Around middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

'Maxwell is bowling submarines here.' That is referring to the angle he is bringing his arm down, clearly inspired from Kedar Jadhav. The ball comes down with a sling, is fired outside off, Akmal looks to push but misses.
Around middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and around off, Sohail comes down the track and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Haris plays it wide of point and keeps the strike. 6 runs off Marcus' first.
Excellent fielding. Good length delivery outside off, Akmal cuts it wide of cover. It is timed well but the fielder dives and stops the ball. Only a single.
On a length, Umar hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Bowls it outside off, Haris drives it to cover for a single.
WIDE! Marcus misses his line and bowls this down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Good length delivery on off, Akmal hits it wide of mid on for a run.
Starts with a good length delivery outside off, Sohail nudges it to deep cover and gets a single.
Marcus Stoinis introduced into the attack.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Akmal comes down the track and taps it back to the bowler. Maxwell has a shy at the stumps at the keeper's end to Carey but Umar is well in.
On the pads, Akmal flicks it away wide of fine leg for a couple.
Shorter on off, Haris cuts it away for a run.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Sohail blocks it.
Loopy delivery on off, Akmal nudges it to long off for a run.
Flighted on off, Akmal blocks it with a straight bat.
Glenn Maxwell is back on. 3-0-14-0 so far.
Single to end the over. Loopy delivery outside off, Umar milks it to cover for a single. Brings 150 for Pakistan.
Play and a miss. Slightly shorter in length. It is too close to cut but Umar attempts it and misses. Carey goes up in appeal but no response from the umpire.
Flighted on off, Haris nudges it wide of mid on this time for a single.
Full on leg, Sohail hits it straight to mid on.
Single now. This time Akmal hits it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flighted on off, Akmal hits it straight to the fielder at cover.
Full and around middle, pushed through mid on for another run.
Landed outside off, steered through third man for one more.
Dropped short, pulled to deep mid-wicket for another single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Nicely done. Sohail needs to get more of these to lift the pressure off Akmal. Full and outside off, Sohail comes down the track and lofts it over cover for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to point.
Nathan Lyon is brought back into the attack.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for another run.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the covers for one more.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Around off, solidly defended towards the off side.
Landed outside off, Akmal just walks into the shot and pushes this through the covers for a single.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack.
Outside off, steered behind point for a couple.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Short and outside off, Sohail looks to cut but gets a bit of an outside edge. Lands short of point.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Around middle, punched towards short mid-wicket.

SIX! Third six of the over and the dot was just the calm before the storm. Overpitched on middle by Jhye. It is in Akmal's zone and he sends this over the long on fence to finish the over. Brings the 50 partnership as well between these two. 19 runs off the over. A very expensive one for Australia.
Not the third six. Full on the pads, Umar flicks it to mid-wicket.

SIX! Two in two for Akmal. Good length delivery on off, Umar rocks onto his back foot and pulls it. Handscomb at square leg is waiting for it. He jumps and gets his outstretched hand to it but it goes behind for six.

SIX! Akmal is done with the waiting game and has decided to take the charge here. Overpitched on middle, Akmal heaves it over mid-wicket. It goes high in the air and has enough to just about clear the fence.
Outside off, pushed straight to mid-wicket.

Outside off, steered behind point for a single. Adam Zampa does really well to run to his left from third man and keep the batsmen to a single. There was always two on that. With that Haris Sohail completes 1000 runs in ODI cricket.
Sohail comes down the track and guides it to long on for a single to keep the strike.
Short again, Akmal this time punches it on the off side for a run.
Shorter outside off, Sohail cuts it away to backward point and gets a single.
Gives it air this time, Haris gets on his front foot and defends it.
Flighted delivery on off, Sohail takes no risk and blocks it.

In the air...and dropped. Flighted delivery outside off, Akmal comes down the track and tries to go over sweeper cover. Handscomb comes ahead and tries to catch it. He gets there and gets both his hands to the ball but the ball pops out of his hand. A lucky escape for Akmal he gets a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, slashed behind point for a run.
Another short ball, Akmal looks to pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, punched uppishly towards mid on. He was halfway through his pull shot there.
Around middle and leg, worked through the leg side for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Jhye Richardson is swung around.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball on the off side. One run added to the total.
Off spinner which is shorter in length, Akmal runs it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Short and spinning away from the southpaw. Sohail gets on his back foot and punches it to backward point for a single.
Tossed up on off, Haris blocks it calmly. Carey goes up in appeal but the umpire is not interested. Don't know what Alex was appealing for.
Full on off, Sohail finds the fielder at cover with his drive.
Shorter in length on middle, Haris tucks it to the fielder at square leg.
Nathan Lyon returns. 6-0-21-1 so far.
Flighted on middle, Akmal brings out the reverse sweep but finds the fielder at backward point.
Flighted on middle, Sohail pushes it to long on for another single.
Full toss this time by Zampa on off, Akmal guides it to long off and gets to the other end.
Flighted outside off, Sohail milks it to cover and rotates the strike.
Tossed up around off, Umar hits it hard but there is fielder for protection at long off so only a single.
Shorter on the leg side, Akmal gets on his back foot and tucks it to the fielder at square leg.
Another flick, another run.

100 UP FOR PAKISTAN. Going at a reasonable rate. All those 350-400 lovers - this is a pitch on the slower side. 250 can be match-winning here. Full and down the leg side, flicked behind square leg for another single.
The seam-up delivery, around middle and leg, Haris plays it watchfully towards cover.
On middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for one more.
On a good length outside off, HS waits for the ball to come to him and guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Just a fraction wide and Sohail pounces. Short in length, outside off, Haris plays it behind point and the ball races away to the fence.
Jhye Richardson is back on.
Goes back and works it with the spin through square leg for one more.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dropped short, we have already seen plenty of these by Zampa so far, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.

NOT OUT. Probably a direct hit might have had Sohail. Full and around middle, Haris worked it through square leg and set off for a single. Umar Akmal had other ideas and Haris had to return. Khawaja got to the ball from square leg, released it with his right hand and Carey deflected the stumps as Haris stretched back in. It was referred upstairs and replays show that the bat was grounded as the bails went up.
Run out appeal! Is Sohail in trouble?
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, played straight to point.

That is a beauty. On a good length, outside off, shaping away, Haris looks to defend but is squared up. The ball goes past the outside edge. A question is asked by the Aussies but nothing much in it. Nothing on the Snicko.
Full and around middle, Haris chips it uppishly but it dies down in front of a lunging Marcus Stoinis at short mid-wicket.
Dropped short, Akmal tries to assert his authority as he pulls it through mid-wicket. Shaun Marsh gives it a good chase from the inner circle and slides near the fence, saving a run for his side.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

EDGED, DROPPED, FOUR! A big mistake from Carey. And understandably so, Zampa is not happy. Keeping is never easy to a spinner but this is international cricket. The googly from Zampa, pitching outside off, turning away, Sohail looked to defend but was beaten by the wrong 'un. The ball took the outside edge and went behind. Alex Carey was probably a touch too early into getting up and his gloves were already to his right as the ball went brushing them, to his left, to the third man fence.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. In fact, leg bye signalled.
On middle and leg, pushed through mid on for one.
Down the leg side, helped straight to square leg.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended. 4 runs and a wicket from the over.
DRINKS BREAK. Umar Akmal walks out to the middle.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! The slower pitch does the trick. The length is short and outside off, Masood looks to play the horizontal pull shot but is a touch too early. Gets a thick inside edge which shatters the stumps. The budding 43-run stand has been broken. Replays show that the ball was delivered cross-seam too.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and around middle, pushed through mid on for a run.

On a good length outside off, Sohail is slightly surprised by the extra bounce as he looks to steer it towards third man. Gets a bit of an outside edge which flies behind point towards third man. A run taken.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Change of pace. Finally. After seeing spin unchanged  since the 7th over, we have a pace bowler. Nathan Coulter-Nile is back on. 3-0-14-0 so far.
Full and outside leg, flicked through square leg for another run.
Short and down the leg side, tucked behind square leg for another single.
Tossed up, this is the googly, around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
This is a touch shorter, around leg, worked through mid-wicket again, this time off the back foot, for a run.
A low full toss, around the leg stump, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and down the leg side, flicked straight to square leg.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for one.
Around middle and off, blocked back respectfully towards Lyon.
Full and around middle, Masood works it through mid-wicket, sets off for a single but then calls it off.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Generously tossed up, around middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
That is a massive long hop, landed right in the middle of the pitch. But it barely arrives and Sohail, who is already through his pull, has to adjust to direct it towards long on. Just a run.
Goes well back and works it through square leg for one more.
Around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside leg, Sohail looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Down the leg side, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, spinning away, Sohail pads it, or looks to pad it away and lets it go.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

JUST OVER, FOUR! Full and around off, Masood comes down the track and looks to go over the on side but skews it. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat and just escapes a leaping mid on fielder to the fence behind.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, punched through point for a couple.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Outside off, the googly, Masood looks to force through the off side but misses. Carey collects and whips the bails off and appeals. Replays show that the back foot did go up when the bails were dislodged but the front foot was always in. So NOT OUT to all the drama.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
More spin. Adam Zampa into the attack now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Around middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, Masood lunges to defend but the ball flies off the outside edge, wide of first slip towards short third man.
Outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run. 50 UP FOR PAKISTAN.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Masood gets his bat down and paddles it extremely fine. Short fine leg has no chance.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for one more.
Around off, driven down to long off for a run.
Full and around off, Sohail comes down the track and drives it through the covers for a single.

'NEVER TRY TO STRAIGHT-DRIVE AN OFF SPINNER,' says an angry Ramiz Raja on air. 'Why give him that option? Always looks to go through mid-wicket or through covers, but never down the ground.' Hmmm... rogering that, Rambo.
Goes back and works it through square leg for one.
Around middle and off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through fine leg for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Down the leg side, flicked straight to short fine leg. 40/1 in Powerplay 1 then.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Comes down the track and works it towards mid on where a misfield allows a single.
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
ALMOST ANOTHER! Full and around middle, Sohail looks to flick but the ball spins away, takes the leading edge and flies past slip! A couple down to third man.
Haris Sohail walks in at number 3, replacing Imam.

OUT! Caught and bowled! The GOAT has its first munch. This has been a regularity in Test matches - Lyon taking caught and bowled dismissals. Today, he has taken one in his very second over. Full and around middle, slightly tossed up, Imam comes down the track and looks to go down the ground - but without much power. Just looks to place it back without bothering to keep it down. Simple catch for the bowler. Pakistan have lost their first.
Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and works it through mid-wicket for a run more.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, spin and extra bounce, punched straight to point.
Down the leg side, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, chipped uppishly towards long off for a single.
Full and around middle, Masood looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
Around off and middle, driven straight back down the ground. Maxwell stops it in his follow-through to his left.
Full and around off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, tossed up slightly, driven down to long off for a single.
WIDE. Fires this down the leg side, Imam misses his flick while Carey fumbles. No run conceded.
Spin from both ends. Glenn Maxwell to roll his arm over.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover-point. Good start from Nathan Lyon.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around middle and off, watchfully blocked back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Imam takes a couple of steps down the track and drives it wide of long off for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around middle, darted through, Imam looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
Spin is in early. Nathan Lyon into the attack.
Full and around middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Excellent fielding from Maxwell. Outside off, Imam punches it through cover and point where the Big Show dives to his left and makes a half-stop. A run taken.
On a good length around middle and off, Imam hops and punches it towards cover.
Nathan Lyon is warming up...
FOUR! Bad bowling. Short ball and in line of the leg stump, Imam swivels and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary! Suddenly, the runs are flowing for Pakistan.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Short in length, around middle, Masood pulls it over mid-wicket and makes it 13 from the over! Pakistan finally pressing on the accelerator.
Full and around middle, watchfully pushed towards the leg side.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A fractionally short in length ball, around off, angling away, Masood goes back and pulls it, albeit unconvincingly, through mid-wicket and finds the boundary at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Full and outside off, Masood leans into this one and drives it through the covers. No stopping that.
Outside off, on a good length, around off, Imam looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which goes past gully towards third man. A single taken.
On a good length outside off, steered towards backward point.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Landed outside off, dabbed straight to backward point.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around off, watchfully kept out.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
SIX! Intent from Imam and that is the first biggie of the evening! A length ball, outside off, Imam dances down the track  and smashes it over long on!
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Full again, driven straight to mid off once more.
Around middle and off, watchfully pushed back towards mid off.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around middle, swinging in, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, Imam goes on the back foot and punches it to the ground.
On a length around middle, Masood flicks it to the on side. The mid on fielder stops it inside the inner circle and the batsmen take a single.
A back of a length outside off going away, Shan reaches for it and plays it towards the covers.
Another full ball outside off, Masood blocks it firmly.
Fuller this time, Masood prods forward and puts it to the ground.
Back of a length ball around off, blocked by the batsman on the front foot.
Starts off with a full ball pitched way outside off going away. It goes outside the white line. Wide signaled.
Nathan Coulter-Nile it will be to bowl with the second new ball.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Landed outside off, not played at. This was well inside the guidelines.
WIDE. Full and well outside off, not played at.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Full and around off, defended back to the bowler.

The players are out in the middle. A minute's silence is being observed in memory of the victims in Christchurch. The players are wearing black arm bands in respect of the same. We are now ready for the game to begin. Jhye Richardson will start off proceedings with the first new ball. Imam-ul-Haq to face. Shan Masood will be the non-striker. Here we go...

PAKISTAN TEAM NEWS - Shan Masood is debuting today in the one-day format. Umar Akmal, Haris Sohail and Mohammad Abbas - all are featuring today. Abbas was tormenting the Aussies with the red ball in October - let us see what does March have in store for them or him.

AUSTRALIAN TEAM NEWS - Scratch what was written regarding the Big Show. Was he unfit for this ODI? Well, they say, every day is a different day. Glenn Maxwell might have been unfit last night and slated not to play. Miraculously, he is PLAYING now. Wow. Would like to meet his doctor or physician. In other news, Ashton Turner will warm the bench, which is another surprise. Pat Cummins of course, being rested, is sensible.
TOSS - We are ready for the spin of the coin. Aaron Finch has not quite got it right and Shoaib Malik will get the first choice. PAKISTAN WILL BAT FIRST.

Playing in the heat is never nice but in the month of March and April, it is even bad. Pakistan would be used to it but Australia would need some time to get used to it. Not surprisingly, even before a game has been played, Glenn Maxwell has been ruled out of this ODI, as tweeted by Cricket Australia. He has some intestinal issues, something which many players struggle to adapt, travelling outside their country. Both units are playing this safely, giving rest to a few seniors and some opportunities to fresh faces. This will definitely not be their main squad heading into the World Cup in a couple of months but if a couple of knockout or standout performances are witnessed, he or they could be wearing that team jersey along with teammates come the World Cup.

Why are Pakistan and Australia playing at this time of the year? Contract issues. The Aussies toured the Middle East for a couple of Tests and three T20Is but ODIs were remaining. That remainder of the tour is scheduled to be played in this month. 10 days, 5 games. Wrapped up. Hello and a warm welcome to the first of the 5-match ODI series between Pakistan and Australia in Sharjah.
